'''Viran''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Banker/Legends|banker]] who lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the banker of [[Ja'Boag]].
